renewable-nonrenewable-sorting.alt: Energy sources sorted into two groups. Nonrenewable, a fixed amount formed over millions of years: coal, oil, natural gas and nuclear fuel. Renewable, replenished at or near the rate we use it: nondepletable sunlight, wind, moving water and Earth's internal heat, and depletable wood, crops and other biomass, renewable only if regrown as fast as used.
